verdict.en: The cheapest way to get guns out of your stash and onto the wall: 3 slots for 10 Sheet Metal.
verdict.zh: 最便宜的壁挂武器架：10 块金属板换 3 个挂位，能把枪从储备箱里腾出来。

use.en: Weapon racks hold guns outside the stash grid. Place it in a room, right-click it and choose Decorate to hang weapons, or "clear all attached items" to send them back to the stash. Three slots is the smallest rack, so it suits a few display or backup guns.
use.zh: 武器架能在储备箱格子之外存放枪械。把它摆进房间，右键选“装饰”挂枪，选“清除所有附加物品”就能收回储备箱。3 个挂位是最小的一款，适合放几把展示枪或备用枪。

obtain.en: Learn the Battered Weapon Rack Design (a Topside find), then craft it at the Research Station for 10 Sheet Metal. Recycling the piece returns the same 10 Sheet Metal.
obtain.zh: 先拿到并学会破旧武器展示架设计图（地表掉落），再到研究站用 10 块金属板制作。拆解成品会返还同样的 10 块金属板。

tips.en: The Sturdy rack costs the same 10 Sheet Metal and has 4 slots, so skip this one if you already own the Sturdy Design.
tips.zh: 坚固武器展示架同样只要 10 块金属板，却有 4 个挂位；已有坚固款设计图就不必做这个。

verdict.en: Best value weapon rack: 4 slots for 10 Sheet Metal, same slots as the Polished one.
verdict.zh: 性价比最高的武器架：10 块金属板换 4 个挂位，与抛光款挂位一样多。

use.en: Holds four guns outside your stash grid. Use it for the weapons you rotate between raids so they stop eating stash space.
use.zh: 可挂 4 把枪，不占储备箱格子。适合放几把常换的备用武器，给战利品腾地方。

obtain.en: Craft at the Research Station after learning the Sturdy Weapon Rack Design from Topside loot. Cost is only 10 Sheet Metal.
obtain.zh: 在地表搜到并学会坚固武器展示架设计图后，到研究站用 10 块金属板制作。

tips.en: Polished costs double the metal plus Plastic Parts for the same 4 slots; it is a cosmetic upgrade only.
tips.zh: 抛光款要两倍金属板外加塑料零件，挂位同样是 4 个，只是外观升级。

verdict.en: Epic-looking rack with no extra slots over the Sturdy one; build it for looks.
verdict.zh: 史诗品质的武器架，挂位并不比坚固款多，主要图个好看。

use.en: Four weapon slots, identical to the Sturdy rack. If you only care about storage, the Sturdy rack is the better deal.
use.zh: 有 4 个挂位，与坚固款相同。只在乎存储的话，坚固款更划算。

obtain.en: Needs its Epic Design from Topside loot, then 20 Sheet Metal and 10 Plastic Parts at the Research Station.
obtain.zh: 需要地表掉落的史诗设计图，再到研究站花 20 块金属板和 10 个塑料零件制作。

verdict.en: Entry-level Stash furniture; cheap, but only worth it if you have the Design to spare.
verdict.zh: 入门级储备箱家具，造价低，有多余设计图再做。

use.en: Adds Outpost storage that is kept apart from your main stash. The wiki still gives no slot count for it; the in-game build menu shows the number for each piece. Crafting materials and Scrappy's food left in Outpost furniture are pulled automatically when you craft, so it works as overflow for materials.
use.zh: 为哨站增加存储，与主储备箱分开计算。维基仍未列出它的格数，游戏内建造菜单里每件家具都会显示。放在哨站家具里的制作材料和废品仔的食物，制作时会自动调用，适合当材料仓。

obtain.en: Learn the Battered Stash Design from Topside loot or Outpost upgrades, then craft with 3 Chemicals and 10 Sheet Metal.
obtain.zh: 从地表或哨站升级拿到破旧储备箱设计图后，用 3 份化学品和 10 块金属板制作。

verdict.en: Mid-tier Stash piece; it needs Voltage Converters, so craft it only once you have the Design.
verdict.zh: 中档储备箱家具，需要变电器，拿到设计图后再造。

use.en: More Outpost storage. Nobody has published its slot count yet, so read it off the build menu before you spend Voltage Converters on it.
use.zh: 更多哨站存储。格数尚无人公布，花变电器之前先在建造菜单里看清。

obtain.en: Craft for 15 Sheet Metal and 3 Voltage Converters after learning the Design.
obtain.zh: 学会设计图后，用 15 块金属板和 3 个变电器制作。

tips.en: Voltage Converters are the bottleneck here; check your stock before recycling electronics.
tips.zh: 变电器是瓶颈，拆解电子零件前先看看库存。

verdict.en: Rare Stash piece that only asks for a single Flow Controller on top of metal.
verdict.zh: 稀有储备箱，除金属板外只多要 1 个流量控制器。

use.en: Another Outpost storage piece. As of 2.0 neither the wiki nor guides list stash capacities; only shelves, cupboards and weapon racks have published numbers.
use.zh: 又一款哨站存储家具。截至2.0，维基和攻略都没有储备箱的格数，只有架子、橱柜和武器展示架公布了数字。

obtain.en: Craft for 15 Sheet Metal and 1 Flow Controller once the Polished Stash Design is learned.
obtain.zh: 学会精致储备箱设计图后，用 15 块金属板和 1 个流量控制器制作。

verdict.en: Top Stash tier; costs 3 Ion Sputters, so build it last.
verdict.zh: 最高阶储备箱，需要 3 个离子溅射仪，最后再造。

use.en: Epic Stash furniture for extra Outpost storage. Its capacity is not published anywhere yet, so compare it with the cheaper stashes in the build menu before paying 3 Ion Sputters.
use.zh: 史诗级储备箱家具，扩充哨站存储。容量还没有公开资料，花3个离子溅射仪前，先在建造菜单里和便宜款比一比。

obtain.en: Craft for 20 Sheet Metal and 3 Ion Sputters after learning the Ornate Stash Design.
obtain.zh: 学会华丽储备箱设计图后，用 20 块金属板和 3 个离子溅射仪制作。

tips.en: Ion Sputters are the pricey part; do not spend them on decor first.
tips.zh: 离子溅射仪是主要成本，别先拿去做装饰品。

verdict.en: The cheapest shelf: 2 slots for 5 Planks.
verdict.zh: 最便宜的架子：5 块木板换 2 个格位。

use.en: A small wall shelf for trinkets and collectibles outside your stash; right-click to Decorate.
use.zh: 放小摆件和收藏品的小壁架，不占储备箱，右键选“装饰”即可摆放。

obtain.en: Learn the Design from Topside loot; craft for 5 Planks.
obtain.zh: 从地表拿到设计图后，用 5 块木板制作。

tips.en: Only 2 slots; upgrade to the Sturdy version if you collect trinkets.
tips.zh: 只有 2 格，收集摆件的话换坚固款。

verdict.en: 3 slots for 10 Planks: a fair step up from Battered.
verdict.zh: 10 块木板换 3 格，比破旧款划算一点。

use.en: Display shelf for small items and trophies; Decorate it from the right-click menu.
use.zh: 用来陈列小物件和战利品，右键选“装饰”摆放。

obtain.en: Craft for 10 Planks after learning the Design.
obtain.zh: 学会设计图后用 10 块木板制作。

verdict.en: 6 slots for 20 Planks; the sweet spot of the Den shelf line.
verdict.zh: 20 块木板换 6 格，巢穴架子系列里性价比最好。

use.en: Six slots for display items; doubles the Sturdy shelf for twice the planks.
use.zh: 6 个格位，木板消耗翻倍，格数也翻倍。

obtain.en: Craft for 20 Planks after learning the Rare Design.
obtain.zh: 学会稀有设计图后用 20 块木板制作。

verdict.en: Biggest Den shelf at 7 slots; only 1 more slot than Polished for 5 more Planks.
verdict.zh: 7 格的最大巢穴架子，比抛光款只多 1 格，多花 5 块木板。

use.en: Seven display slots at Epic quality.
use.zh: 史诗品质，7 个格位。

obtain.en: Craft for 25 Planks once the Design is learned.
obtain.zh: 学会设计图后用 25 块木板制作。

tips.en: If planks are tight, the Polished shelf gives almost the same space.
tips.zh: 木板紧张的话，抛光款的空间几乎一样。

verdict.en: 12 slots for just 10 Sheet Metal: great display space for the price.
verdict.zh: 10 块金属板换 12 格，价格极低的展示空间。

use.en: A large shelf compared with the Den line. Use it for collectibles you want out of the stash.
use.zh: 比巢穴架子大得多，适合放想从储备箱里拿出来的收藏品。

obtain.en: Craft for 10 Sheet Metal once the Chambers Shelf Design is learned.
obtain.zh: 学会商会架子设计图后用 10 块金属板制作。

verdict.en: The biggest storage listing on the wiki: 16 slots, but it needs research.
verdict.zh: 维基上格数最多的存储家具：16 格，但需要研究。

use.en: 16 slots makes this the best pick for freeing stash space among listed pieces.
use.zh: 16 格，是已列出家具里腾出储备箱空间的最佳选择。

obtain.en: Needs 1000 RP and 40 Planks of research, then 1 Metal Brackets and 20 Planks to craft.
obtain.zh: 需要 1000 研究点数和 40 块木板的研究投入，制作再花 1 个金属支架和 20 块木板。

verdict.en: Legendary showpiece with 3 slots; expensive for what it does.
verdict.zh: 传说级展示品，有 3 格，花费偏高。

use.en: Mostly a showpiece, though it has 3 attached slots.
use.zh: 主要用来摆场面，带 3 个格位。

obtain.en: Costs 50 Planks and 3 Advanced Mechanical Components; one guide notes a Design was found under a car hood on Dam Battlegrounds.
obtain.zh: 需要 50 块木板和 3 个高级机械元件；有攻略称曾在大坝战场的车引擎盖下找到设计图。

verdict.en: Seasonal plant decor built from seeds and fertilizer.
verdict.zh: 用种子和肥料做的绿植装饰。

use.en: Pure decoration, no slots.
use.zh: 纯装饰，没有格位。

obtain.en: Craft for 30 Assorted Seeds and 3 Fertilizer. Recycling returns the seeds and fertilizer.
obtain.zh: 用 30 份混合种子和 3 份肥料制作，拆解会返还种子和肥料。

verdict.en: Lab cabinets are Sheet Metal storage pieces; the Sturdy ones are cheaper to research.
verdict.zh: 实验室柜是金属板系列的存储家具，坚固款研究更便宜。

use.en: Lab-style storage cabinets. The wiki's furniture table gives slot counts only for shelves and cupboards (Chambers Shelf 12, Diner Cupboard 16), not for these cabinets, so check the build menu. Guides say cabinets hold trinkets, crafting materials and food.
use.zh: 实验室风格的储物柜。维基家具表只给了架子和橱柜的格数（商会架子12格、小餐馆橱柜16格），没有这些柜子的，请在建造菜单里查看。攻略称柜子能放饰品、制作材料和食物。

obtain.en: Research costs range from 500 RP (Sturdy, Small) to 1000 RP (Battered, Blue), plus metal parts and plastic.
obtain.zh: 研究点数从 500（坚固款、小型）到 1000（破旧款、蓝色），另需金属和塑料材料。

verdict.en: Three shelving units; all need research, and Sturdy costs the most metal.
verdict.zh: 三款置物架都要研究，坚固款耗金属最多。

use.en: Wall or standing shelves for display.
use.zh: 用来陈列的壁架或立式架。

obtain.en: Battered and Sturdy need 1000 RP and a Rusted Bolt; Diner needs 1500 RP and a Laser Level.
obtain.zh: 破旧款和坚固款要 1000 研究点数和 1 个生锈螺栓；餐馆架子要 1500 点数和 1 个激光水平仪。

verdict.en: Wardrobes are bulky decor; Sturdy is the cheap one.
verdict.zh: 衣柜体积大，主要是装饰，坚固款最便宜。

use.en: Standing wardrobes: Alpine and Ornate use Planks, Sturdy and Polished use metal. No slot count is published for any wardrobe yet. Items go in from the furniture's right-click menu, and you can send them all back to the stash in one go.
use.zh: 立式衣柜：高山和华丽款用木板，坚固和抛光款用金属。目前没有任何衣柜的格数资料。物品通过家具的右键菜单放入，也能一键全部退回储备箱。

obtain.en: Sturdy: 8 Sheet Metal and 4 Plastic Parts; Ornate: 50 Planks and 2 Metal Brackets.
obtain.zh: 坚固款 8 块金属板加 4 个塑料零件；华丽款 50 块木板加 2 个金属支架。

verdict.en: Assorted dressers and cabinets; a few need research before crafting.
verdict.zh: 各式五斗柜和柜子，部分需先研究。

use.en: Furniture for decorating rooms; the storage pieces among them hold items, but their slot counts are not published yet.
use.zh: 装饰房间用的家具；其中能存储的几件可以放物品，但格数尚未公开。

obtain.en: Venetian Dresser needs 25 Planks, Console Chest 20 Planks; the rest need research of 500 to 1500 RP.
obtain.zh: 威尼斯梳妆台要 25 块木板，控制台宝箱要 20 块；其余需要 500 到 1500 研究点数。

verdict.en: Beds are decor only; Battered is nearly free.
verdict.zh: 床只是装饰，破旧款几乎不花钱。

use.en: Four tiers of the same bed.
use.zh: 同一款床的四个档次。

obtain.en: Battered needs 2 Sheet Metal and a Torn Blanket; Ornate needs 20 Planks and 2 Very Comfortable Pillows.
obtain.zh: 破旧款 2 块金属板加 1 条破损的毯子；华丽款 20 块木板加 2 个极为舒适的枕头。

verdict.en: Cheap everyday tables; decor.
verdict.zh: 便宜的日常桌子，纯装饰。

use.en: Plain tables for rooms.
use.zh: 给房间用的普通桌子。

obtain.en: Mostly 14-20 Sheet Metal plus plastic or rubber; some need 500 to 1000 RP.
obtain.zh: 多数要 14 到 20 块金属板加塑料或橡胶；部分需要 500 到 1000 研究点数。

verdict.en: Higher-tier tables with heavier research costs.
verdict.zh: 高档桌子，研究成本较高。

use.en: Decor tables.
use.zh: 装饰桌。

obtain.en: Diner Table needs 2000 RP and a Statuette; others need 1500 RP and a Laser Level or similar.
obtain.zh: 小餐馆桌子要 2000 研究点数和 1 个小雕像；其余要 1500 点数和激光水平仪之类的材料。

verdict.en: Basic sofas; Bureau ones are the cheapest.
verdict.zh: 基础沙发，办公沙发最便宜。

use.en: Seating decor.
use.zh: 座椅装饰。

obtain.en: Battered Bureau Sofa: 1 Spring Cushion and 10 Planks.
obtain.zh: 破旧办公沙发：1 个弹簧靠枕和 10 块木板。

verdict.en: Two Rare geometric sofas at identical cost.
verdict.zh: 两款稀有几何沙发，造价相同。

use.en: Decor.
use.zh: 装饰。

obtain.en: Each needs 5 Durable Cloth and 15 Sheet Metal.
obtain.zh: 各需 5 份耐磨布料和 15 块金属板。

verdict.en: Top-end seating; needs Spring Cushions and research.
verdict.zh: 高档座椅，需要弹簧靠枕和研究。

use.en: Decor seating.
use.zh: 座椅装饰。

obtain.en: Tufted Sofa needs 2000 RP and 3 Very Comfortable Pillows; Round and Red Study need 1500 RP.
obtain.zh: 绗缝沙发要 2000 研究点数和 3 个极为舒适的枕头；圆形沙发和红色书房沙发要 1500 点数。

verdict.en: Office and lab chairs: cheap decor; Hotel Chair comes from the unlock project.
verdict.zh: 办公和实验室椅子，便宜的装饰；酒店座椅来自哨站解锁项目。

use.en: Seating.
use.zh: 座椅。

obtain.en: Most cost 5-8 Sheet Metal plus fabric or plastic. The Hotel Chair Design is the Sheltered Retreat stage 3 reward.
obtain.zh: 多数要 5 到 8 块金属板加布料或塑料。酒店椅设计图是“庇护所”项目第 3 阶段奖励。

verdict.en: Four Rare fabric chairs; Durable Cloth is the cost.
verdict.zh: 四款稀有布艺椅，主要消耗耐磨布料。

use.en: Seating.
use.zh: 座椅。

obtain.en: 3 to 5 Durable Cloth and 10 to 15 Sheet Metal each.
obtain.zh: 每把要 3 到 5 份耐磨布料和 10 到 15 块金属板。

verdict.en: Three cheap stools.
verdict.zh: 三款便宜的凳子。

use.en: Seating.
use.zh: 座椅。

obtain.en: Barstool: 4 Fabric, 8 Sheet Metal. Diner Stool needs 500 RP.
obtain.zh: 吧台凳：4 份布料和 8 块金属板。餐馆凳子需要 500 研究点数。

verdict.en: Ceiling lamps are cheap, 10 Sheet Metal and a bulb or two.
verdict.zh: 吸顶灯很便宜，10 块金属板加一两个灯泡。

use.en: Lighting decor.
use.zh: 灯光装饰。

obtain.en: Each takes 10 Sheet Metal and 1 or 2 Light Bulbs.
obtain.zh: 每盏要 10 块金属板和 1 到 2 个灯泡。

verdict.en: Floor lamps and specials; Chandelier is the Legendary one.
verdict.zh: 落地灯和特色灯，吊灯是传说级。

use.en: Lighting decor.
use.zh: 灯光装饰。

obtain.en: Chandelier: 3 Candle Holders and 20 Sheet Metal. Work Light: 3 Red Light Sticks.
obtain.zh: 吊灯：3 个烛台和 20 块金属板。工作灯：3 根红色荧光棒。

verdict.en: Cheap debris decor: 5 Planks and 5 Fabric each.
verdict.zh: 便宜的残骸装饰：每件 5 块木板加 5 份布料。

use.en: Decor, no slots.
use.zh: 纯装饰，无格位。

obtain.en: All six cost the same.
obtain.zh: 六件造价相同。

verdict.en: A cheap, safe research: 1,000 damage with the Hairpin is a few raids of normal play.
verdict.zh: 门槛很低：用“发夹”打出1000点伤害，正常玩几局就够。

use.en: Completing it opens the Amplified perk path tied to the Jupiter and Osprey (players link it to their scoped options; the exact perk mapping is not confirmed). Each Amplified research also costs 5,000 Research Points and a stack of Sentinel Firing Cores.
use.zh: 完成后可解锁木星与鱼鹰的增强强化路线（玩家推测与瞄具方向相关，具体对应关系未证实）。每项增强研究还要消耗5000研究点数和一批哨卫发射核心。

obtain.en: Take a Hairpin into any raid and shoot ARC or Raiders until the counter hits 1,000. Damage counts across raids, so a cheap kit is fine. The Sentinel Firing Cores are the real bottleneck, so start farming Sentinels early.
obtain.zh: 带着“发夹”进任何一局，打ARC或玩家直到累计1000点。伤害可跨局累计，带便宜配置即可。真正卡人的是哨卫发射核心，要提前去打哨卫。

tips.en: Only worth doing early if you plan to amplify the Jupiter or Osprey; otherwise skip it.
tips.zh: 只有打算增强木星或鱼鹰时才值得早做，否则可以先放着。

verdict.en: Hard-ish and Equalizer-only: do it only if you already run the Equalizer.
verdict.zh: 要求偏高且只服务“制裁者”：不用这把枪就别急着做。

use.en: It unlocks the Equalizer's Amplified research path. The cost is 5,000 Research Points plus 2 Queen Reactors, which are among the toughest ARC drops, so this is a late-game project.
use.zh: 解锁“制裁者”的增强研究路线。除5000研究点数外还要2个女王反应堆，这是最难拿的ARC掉落之一，属于后期项目。

obtain.en: You need 1,500 damage to Vaporizers with an Equalizer in a single round, so find Vaporizers first and keep your ammo for them. The Equalizer blueprint itself only comes from the Harvester event.
obtain.zh: 需要在单局内用“制裁者”对“汽化者”打出1500点伤害，所以要先找到“汽化者”，把弹药留给它们。“制裁者”蓝图本身只能通过收割者事件获得。

tips.en: The damage must happen in one round, so do not split it across raids.
tips.zh: 伤害必须在单局内完成，别分几局打。

verdict.en: Only for Burletta fans, and gated by Shredders, which are hard to find.
verdict.zh: 只对“布尔莱塔”玩家有用，而且“粉碎者”不好找。

use.en: Unlocks a Burletta Amplified research path. Needs 20 Pop Triggers on top of 5,000 Research Points.
use.zh: 解锁“布尔莱塔”的一条增强研究路线。除5000研究点数外还要20个弹出式扳机。

obtain.en: Destroy 3 Shredders with a Raider Tool. One guide says Shredders are currently exclusive to Stella Montis, so plan runs there. Shredder Gyros from the same kills are also needed by Speranza projects, so you get double value.
obtain.zh: 用奇袭工具摧毁3个“粉碎者”。有攻略称“粉碎者”目前只在星辰山出现，所以要专门跑那张图。同样的击杀掉落的“粉碎者”陀螺仪也是斯佩兰扎项目所需，一举两得。

tips.en: Bring several Raider Tools: the objective needs the tool to do the destroying, not your gun.
tips.zh: 多带几个奇袭工具：目标要求由工具摧毁，不是用枪打。

verdict.en: Easy if you carry Blaze Grenades: 3,000 damage over a few raids.
verdict.zh: 带火焰手雷就不难：几局内累计3000点伤害。

use.en: Unlocks Amplified research for the Hullcracker and Rascal. Also needs 5 Bombardier Cells and 5,000 Research Points.
use.zh: 解锁“裂甲者”和“无赖”的增强研究。另需5个投弹手电池和5000研究点数。

obtain.en: Throw Blaze Grenades at ARC groups or at any target standing in the burn zone, since the objective counts total damage. Bombardier Cells come from Bombardiers, so combine both goals.
obtain.zh: 把火焰手雷扔向ARC群或站在燃烧区的目标，目标统计总伤害。投弹手电池来自“投弹手”，可以两件事一起做。

tips.en: Craft Blaze Grenades in bulk before starting; a few raids of grenade-only play finishes it.
tips.zh: 先批量制作火焰手雷，几局专心扔雷就能完成。

verdict.en: The most tedious research: four ARC types, 1,000 grenade damage each.
verdict.zh: 最繁琐的研究之一：四种ARC，每种用手雷打1000点。

use.en: Unlocks Amplified research for the Anvil, Bettina and Kettle, so it matters if you use any of the three. Also needs 5 Rocketeer Drivers.
use.zh: 解锁“铁砧”“贝蒂娜”“水壶”的增强研究，用其中任何一把都值得做。另需5个火箭手引擎。

obtain.en: Use Light Impact Grenades on Fireflies, Hornets, Fireballs and Surveyors, 1,000 damage each. Fireballs are mostly in bunkers or underground, such as the Buried City Metro entrances and the big Blue Gate bunker, so do them last. Fireflies, Hornets and Surveyors are flying or drone ARC you meet in the open.
obtain.zh: 用轻型冲击手雷分别对萤火虫、马蜂、火球和勘测师打出1000点伤害。火球多在地堡或地下，如掩埋废城的地铁入口和蓝门的大地堡，放最后做。萤火虫、马蜂、勘测师在野外较常见。

tips.en: Each ARC type has its own counter, so check progress after every raid instead of throwing everything at one target.
tips.zh: 每种ARC各自计数，每局结束后看进度，别把雷都扔在同一种目标上。

verdict.en: A grind: 10,000 damage, but it covers two weapons.
verdict.zh: 要刷：1000点变成10000点，不过能服务两把枪。

use.en: Unlocks Amplified research for the Aphelion and Burletta. Also needs 10 Comet Igniters.
use.zh: 解锁“远日点”和“布尔莱塔”的增强研究。另需10个彗星点火器。

obtain.en: Deal 10,000 damage with a Burst Burletta or a Charged Burst Aphelion. Both are burst setups from the Amplified tree, so expect to amplify one first. Damage counts over many raids.
obtain.zh: 用连发形态的“布尔莱塔”或蓄力连发形态的“远日点”打出10000点伤害。这两种都是增强后的配置，所以必须先把其中一把增强成对应形态才能开始计数，伤害可跨多局累计。

tips.en: Do this after you finish easier projects; it is one of the longest grinds in the list.
tips.zh: 放在较简单的项目之后，它是清单里最耗时的刷伤害项目之一。

verdict.en: Simple and cheap: blow up 5 ARC Turbines for the Aphelion path.
verdict.zh: 简单便宜：炸掉5个ARC涡轮，解锁“远日点”路线。

use.en: Unlocks Amplified research for the Aphelion. Also needs 5 Leaper Pulse Units, which drop from Leapers.
use.zh: 解锁“远日点”的增强研究。另需5个跳跃者脉冲单元，来自“跳跃者”。

obtain.en: Destroy any ARC Turbine you come across, preferably with explosives, and hunt Leapers on the same run for the Pulse Units. I found no community page listing turbine spots, so check the map for them in game.
obtain.zh: 遇到ARC涡轮就摧毁，最好用爆炸物，同一局顺便去打“跳跃者”拿脉冲单元。没有找到社区页面列出涡轮位置，请在游戏内地图中确认。

tips.en: Explosives make it fast. Only worth early if you want an amplified Aphelion.
tips.zh: 用爆炸物最快。只有想要增强版“远日点”时才值得早做。

verdict.en: Expensive: killing a Bastion with the Rattler alone is the hard part.
verdict.zh: 成本高：只用“响尾蛇”击杀“堡垒”是难点。

use.en: Unlocks the Rattler's Amplified path, which includes the drum magazine (+40 rounds, at the cost of more recoil and slower aim-down-sights). Also needs 5 Bastion Cells.
use.zh: 解锁“响尾蛇”的增强路线，其中包含弹鼓（弹匣+40发，但后坐力更大、开镜更慢）。另需5个“堡垒”电池。

obtain.en: Deal 15,000 damage to a Bastion with a Rattler and destroy 1 Bastion with it. The usual Bastion advice is to hit the weak spots and joints, and to bring explosives, but explosives will not count here, so bring a lot of ammo and a squad to distract it.
obtain.zh: 用“响尾蛇”对“堡垒”造成15000点伤害并摧毁1个。通用打法是瞄准弱点和腿部关节，并带爆炸物，但这里爆炸物不计入，所以要带足弹药，最好有队友吸引火力。

tips.en: Rattler damage on a Bastion is slow, so plan for a long fight and a safe fallback.
tips.zh: “响尾蛇”打“堡垒”比较慢，要预留长时间战斗和安全撤退路线。

verdict.en: A sightseeing quest: visit seven locations, no combat required.
verdict.zh: 跑图型任务：到七个地点打卡，不强制战斗。

use.en: Unlocks the Sprint Shooting perk path for the Burletta, Canto, Hairpin and Rascal (the link is inferred from the weapons that offer the perk). It also needs 20 Skulker Drivers.
use.zh: 解锁“布尔莱塔”“颂歌”“发夹”“无赖”的冲刺射击路线（对应关系由拥有该强化的武器推断）。另需20个“潜伏者”引擎。

obtain.en: Visit the Electrical Substation, Truck Stop, Old Town, Almatera Station, Researcher Lodgings, Deep-Space Telescope and Commissary Supermarket. They are spread over several maps, so tick off two or three per raid with a light kit. The 20 Skulker Drivers are the real work.
obtain.zh: 前往变电站、卡车停靠站、老城区、阿尔玛特拉站、研究员住所区、深空望远镜和军需超市。它们分布在不同地图，每局带轻装备顺路完成两三处即可。真正耗时的是20个“潜伏者”引擎。

tips.en: Combine visits with loot runs. Old Town and the Commissary Supermarket are also good for Outpost materials.
tips.zh: 打卡和搜刮一起做，老城区和军需超市也是哨站材料的好去处。

verdict.en: Only 700 damage to Raiders, but 2 Matriarch Reactors make it a late project.
verdict.zh: 只要对玩家造成700点伤害，但需要2个族母反应堆，属于后期项目。

use.en: Unlocks the Kettle's Amplified path, including the Anti-Shield variants. Needs 2 Matriarch Reactors and 5,000 Research Points.
use.zh: 解锁“水壶”的增强路线，包括反护盾变体。需要2个族母反应堆和5000研究点数。

obtain.en: The objective counts damage to encountered Raiders, so a few fights in a PvP-heavy map finish it, and the damage does not need to be a kill. The Matriarch Reactors come from the Matriarch, which is the real obstacle.
obtain.zh: 目标统计对遇到的玩家造成的伤害，在PvP较多的地图打几场即可，不必击杀。族母反应堆来自“族母”，这才是真正的障碍。

tips.en: Do the damage when you meet Raiders anyway; do not go hunting players just for this.
tips.zh: 遇到玩家时顺手完成，不必专门去找人打。

verdict.en: A shotgun grind: 50 flying ARC, only worth it for the Il Toro.
verdict.zh: 霰弹枪刷怪：击落50个飞行ARC，只有用“公牛”才值得。

use.en: Unlocks the Il Toro's Amplified research. Also needs 20 Tick Pods.
use.zh: 解锁“公牛”的增强研究。另需20个跳蚤荚。

obtain.en: Destroy 50 flying ARC with shotguns. Wasps, Hornets and Fireflies are flying ARC, and Pendola Pass has plenty of flyers. Shotguns are strongest up close, so wait for drones to dive at you.
obtain.zh: 用霰弹枪摧毁50个飞行ARC。黄蜂、马蜂和萤火虫都算飞行ARC，彭多拉山口飞行单位很多。霰弹枪近距离最强，等无人机俯冲过来再打。

tips.en: The 20 Tick Pods are as much work as the kills, so farm Ticks in the same runs.
tips.zh: 20个跳蚤荚的工作量不亚于击杀，同一局顺便刷“跳蚤”。

verdict.en: A long flyer hunt, worth it for the Equalizer and Osprey.
verdict.zh: 要长时间打飞行ARC，用“制裁者”和“鱼鹰”才值得。

use.en: Unlocks Amplified research for the Equalizer and Osprey (the Osprey's anti-weak-point option fits the theme). Also needs 20 Fireball Burners.
use.zh: 解锁“制裁者”和“鱼鹰”的增强研究（“鱼鹰”的弱点强化方向与此吻合）。另需20个“火球”燃烧炉。

obtain.en: Destroy 40 thrusters on flying ARC. Shooting thrusters, not bodies, is what counts, so aim at the engines. Fireball Burners are the harder part because Fireballs are mostly in bunkers or underground.
obtain.zh: 摧毁飞行ARC的40个推进器。要打的是推进器而不是机身，请瞄准引擎。“火球”燃烧炉更难，因为火球多在地堡或地下。

tips.en: Fireball Burners are also needed for the Refiner upgrade, so keep them.
tips.zh: “火球”燃烧炉还用于升级精加工机，请先留着。

verdict.en: The best-value research: it unlocks incendiary rounds on four weapons.
verdict.zh: 性价比最高的研究：为四把武器解锁燃烧弹。

use.en: Opens the incendiary path for the Aphelion, Canto, Hairpin and Rattler, which adds burn damage over time. It also needs 5 Firefly Burners.
use.zh: 为“远日点”“颂歌”“发夹”“响尾蛇”开启燃烧弹路线，增加持续灼烧伤害。另需5个萤火虫燃烧炉。

obtain.en: Destroy 30 Fireballs with Explosive Mines. Fireballs hide in bunkers and underground, such as the Buried City Metro entrances and the large Blue Gate bunker, so lay mines on their patrol paths. Fireballs spawn infrequently, so expect many raids.
obtain.zh: 用爆炸地雷摧毁30个火球。火球多在地堡和地下，如掩埋废城地铁入口、蓝门大地堡，把地雷放在它们的巡逻路线上。火球刷新不多，需要多局。

tips.en: Mines are cheap, but each kill sets the area on fire, so retreat before collecting.
tips.zh: 地雷便宜，但击杀会引燃周围，等火熄了再去捡。

verdict.en: Quick: visit Pilgrim's Peak and deal 1,000 damage with an Osprey.
verdict.zh: 很快：去朝圣峰，再用“鱼鹰”打出1000点伤害。

use.en: Unlocks scope upgrades in the Amplified paths of the Jupiter and Renegade (as listed by the keengamer guide). Also needs 14 Snitch Scanners.
use.zh: 解锁“木星”和“叛逆”增强路线中的瞄具升级（来自玩家攻略的列表）。另需14个告密者扫描仪。

obtain.en: On Blue Gate head to Pilgrim's Peak and shoot ARC with an Osprey, 1,000 damage in total. The objective is cheap, but you need to own the Osprey and a Pilgrim's Peak Security Code may be needed to enter parts of the area.
obtain.zh: 在蓝门前往朝圣峰，用“鱼鹰”攻击ARC，累计1000点。目标本身便宜，但需要拥有“鱼鹰”，进入该区域部分地点可能需要朝圣峰安全码。

tips.en: Snitch Scanners come from Snitches, so farm them alongside.
tips.zh: 告密者扫描仪来自“告密者”，可以一起刷。

verdict.en: Cheap: 5 Skulkers with a Raider Tool, unlocks the Bettina and Hairpin paths.
verdict.zh: 便宜：用奇袭工具打掉5个潜伏者，解锁“贝蒂娜”和“发夹”路线。

use.en: Unlocks Amplified research for the Bettina and Hairpin. Also needs 4 Vaporizer Regulators.
use.zh: 解锁“贝蒂娜”和“发夹”的增强研究。另需4个“汽化者”调节器。

obtain.en: Destroy 5 Skulkers with a Raider Tool. Skulkers ambush then glide away, and explosives destroy them easily, so a Raider Tool placed near their ambush spot works. They are tied to low-visibility weather such as blizzards and storms.
obtain.zh: 用奇袭工具摧毁5个“潜伏者”。它们先埋伏再滑行撤离，爆炸物很容易消灭，把奇袭工具放在它们埋伏点附近就行。它们与暴风雪、风暴等低能见度天气有关。

tips.en: Skulker Targeters from the same kills are needed for Research Station level 2.
tips.zh: 同样的击杀掉落的“潜伏者”瞄准组件还要用于研究站2级升级。

verdict.en: Pure cosmetics: keep them for your main gun, nothing here changes stats.
verdict.zh: 纯外观：留给常用武器，不影响任何数值。

use.en: Learn a stencil from your inventory, then apply it to a matching weapon for Stencil Parts: 2 for Common or Uncommon, 4 Rare, 7 Epic, 15 Legendary. It stays on after death. Garnet and Ochre fit nearly every weapon; Dusty Camo fits Il Toro, Burletta, Torrente, Stiletto, Rattler and Tempest; Tortoise only Anvil and Rattler; Empyrean only the Osprey. Bulwark is Hullcracker-only, Serac Bobcat-only, Sacrifice Renegade-only.
use.zh: 在背包里学会贴花，再花贴花组件应用到匹配武器上：普通或优秀2个、稀有4个、史诗7个、传奇15个，死亡后仍保留。石榴石和赭石几乎适配所有武器；荒漠迷彩适配“公牛”“布尔莱塔”“奔流”“细剑”“响尾蛇”“风暴”；陆龟只适配“铁砧”和“响尾蛇”；九重天只适配“鱼鹰”。壁垒专属“裂甲者”，冰塔专属“山猫”，献祭专属“叛逆”。

obtain.en: Topside stencils drop at random from containers, lockers and key rooms. Named spots so far are all on Pendola Pass: Dusty Camo in the Staff Room boxes of the Commissary Supermarket, Tortoise in a green trash can in its second-floor office, Cerulean in the Observatory key room. Empyrean, Fortuna, Sacrifice, Serac and Bulwark come only from the Premium Pass; Dragon's Breath from the Collector Set.
obtain.zh: 地表贴花随机出自容器、储物柜和钥匙房。目前点名的位置都在彭多拉山口：荒漠迷彩在军需超市员工室的箱子里，陆龟在超市二楼办公室的绿色垃圾桶里，苍蓝在天文台钥匙房。九重天、命运女神、献祭、冰塔、壁垒只能从高级通行证拿，龙息来自收藏家套装。

tips.en: Stencil Parts come from suitcases, wardrobes, dressers, kitchen cabinets, lockers and breachable containers; one guide gets 15 to 17 from one sweep of Stella Montis's Lobby and Business Center.
tips.zh: 贴花组件出自手提箱、衣柜、五斗柜、厨柜、储物柜和可破拆容器；有攻略扫一遍星辰山大厅和商务中心能拿15到17个。

tips.en: Check the weapon list before spending parts, because only stencils you have learned and that fit the gun are offered.
tips.zh: 花贴花组件前先看适配武器，只有已学会且适配的贴花才会出现。

tips.en: Reported rarities from outside sources differ on a few stencils, so trust the in-game rarity.
tips.zh: 外部来源对个别贴花的稀有度说法不一，以游戏内为准。

verdict.en: Rooms are mostly style: the slots raise your Outpost level, but the look is your choice.
verdict.zh: 房间主要是风格选择：房间位提升哨站等级，外观随你喜欢。

use.en: The Base Room is included. You can add three of four optional rooms (Panoramic, Timeless, Chalet, Studious), and they cannot be moved or swapped once placed. Each room raises the cap for the Research Station and Gunsmith, and level 4 is needed for Amplified weapons. Players call Chalet the nicest and Timeless the least appealing.
use.zh: 基础房间自带。四个可选房间（全景、永恒、木屋、研究室）可选三个，放置后无法移动或更换。每个房间提高研究站和武器工作台的等级上限，4级才能做增强武器。玩家普遍认为木屋最好看，永恒最一般。

obtain.en: Unlock the Outpost first (Raider level 18, then the three-stage Sheltered Retreat project). Then expand with the plus icon. The first expansion costs 3 Steel Cables, 20 Sheet Metal and 3 Cable Strippers; later ones cost more, and cost follows the slot rather than the room.
obtain.zh: 先解锁哨站（突袭者等级18，完成三阶段“庇护所”项目），再点加号扩建。首次扩建需要3个钢缆、20个金属板和3个电缆剥线钳，后续更贵，费用取决于房间位而不是房间种类。

tips.en: Sources disagree on when the Studious Room becomes available, so check in game.
tips.zh: 各来源对研究室何时可选说法不一，请以游戏内为准。
